findings.title: sharp < 0.35.4 heap-buffer-overflow via wrangler → miniflare
findings.detail: Installed sharp 0.35.2 (transitive: wrangler → miniflare → sharp) is affected by GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (heap buffer overflow in libheif, CVE-tagged CWE-122). npm audit reports 3 high-severity findings: sharp, miniflare, wrangler. A fix is available via npm audit fix.
findings.suggested_fix: Run npm audit fix to upgrade the wrangler → miniflare → sharp chain to sharp >= 0.35.4

findings.title: react and react-dom are 1 major version behind (18.x → 19.x)
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom to ^18.3.1; latest stable is 19.3.0. React 19 is a major release with breaking changes (Actions API, use() hook, stricter StrictMode). Manual migration and testing required.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react and react-dom to ^19.3.0 in package.json and resolve any breaking changes

findings.title: src/web/App.tsx recently modified but has no unit test
findings.detail: src/web/App.tsx was changed in the last 14 days (About page copy + footer layout fixes) but no App.test.tsx or App.test.ts exists alongside it. Other web modules in the same directory do have sibling test files.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/web/App.test.tsx with at minimum a smoke-render test using @testing-library/react
